Odisha weather update shows a major shift as the monsoon is expected to weaken after heavy rainfall and floods in July. Meteorological predictions indicate reduced rainfall activity in August, leading to rising temperatures and hotter conditions across the state. This sudden transition from floods to heat may impact daily life, agriculture, and water availability. The weakening monsoon trend is also part of a broader weather pattern seen across parts of India. Watch this report to understand what lies ahead for Odisha’s weather and how it may affect the coming days.
